evidence.name: Screen field: Optional icon on the button
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Optional icon on the button" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Optional icon on the button
sections.description: Adds a small image beside the button label, positioned left or right of the text, with controls for its size and surrounding spacing. Use a simple icon to reinforce the action — like an arrow on a 'Continue' button — and upload a transparent PNG or SVG so it sits cleanly. Leave it empty for a clean text-only button.
